newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.80 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.80 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at 14.80 ringgit ($5.85) a kg, after a similar overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), dealers said.
"There were sellers for 118 tonnes against buyers for 98 tonnes initially," said a dealer. "But they matched positions to follow the LME."
Final turnover was 98 tonnes against 129 tonnes on Thursday. The local price premium over LME rose to $25 a tonne from $20 previously. Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia.
